sources.title: Tables of composition and nutritional values of feed materials (INRAE, CIRAD, AFZ, FAO)
sources.notes: Compilation of analyses from private and public feed laboratories, mostly France and Western Europe (feedtables.com, Principles and methods). Mean, SD, min, max and n on every value. An asterisk marks a value PREDICTED from a regression equation; which equation is not published, so a predicted value cannot be checked, only judged plausible.

rows.flag: THE OBJECT IS REJECTED PEAS, THE TABLE IS SOUND SEED. The register places this row at primary production and the food industry with no fraction named, which reads as the pea itself - rejected, out-of-spec or unharvested. Feedipedia node 264 describes MARKETABLE dry pea seed. Dry matter is the first thing that will not carry: 86,5 percent as-fed is a stored dry seed, where a rejected green pea leaving a vining line is nearer 20 percent. The dry-basis composition is the usable part.
rows.notes: as-fed basis, and it is STORED DRY SEED - not a rejected green pea
